title: Kit Green knew Ransone but refuses to talk

tellings.quote: he knew Vallee Ransone really well and

plain: An unnamed researcher on Jesse Michels's podcast says that a man named Kit Green knew a woman named Valerie Ransone very well in the late 1970s and early 1980s. According to the researcher, Green will not talk about her. The episode is about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council, so Green's silence would matter if he holds part of that story.
